summary: Every course must be letter graded and taken for at least 3 units. The minor is EDUC 101, two foundational courses and three electives in one subfield, at least six courses and between 20 and 30 units. The three listed subfields are suggestions, so electives from a subfield of your own are moved in by hand. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA, and that none of these courses also counts toward another major or minor.
